column2: 1.1 Policy framework

column2:
Are there any activities in place to assist data holders with publishing their data as open data (i.e. to help them with the data opening process)?

For Explanation:
* If yes, please describe/provide examples of these activities.
column4: new question
column7:
Part of our data categorisation process includes a traffic light notation system. Green data is data that can be made available as open data (according to the data owner) but may not adhere to an open data specification. Example the data owner for Tourism datasets used to expose excel sheets. We made the data owner aware of the 5 star schema and the changes required to categorise this data as open data.

As a team we provide consultancy services to Government entities. We also embarked on an exercise to go through the Laws of Malta and extract any data obligations each Ministry has on maintaining data (both open and closed data) and are working towards including these dataset in the Data Catalogue.
